sqlite_version: NOT RUN: D1 denies sqlite_version() function

plans.query:
WITH blocked AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT id,blocked_at FROM requesters WHERE blocked_at IS NOT NULL),
 indexed AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT r.id,r.slug,r.terms
 FROM penny_suggestions_public_rows r
 JOIN boards b ON b.id=r.board_id LEFT JOIN blocked author ON author.id=r.author_requester_id
 WHERE 
  r.moderation_state = 'approved'
  AND r.published_at IS NOT NULL
  AND r.withdrawn_at IS NULL
  AND r.merged_into_request_id IS NULL
  AND r.public_state NOT IN ('unpublished','withdrawn')
  AND b.visibility = 'public'
  AND (author.id IS NULL OR author.blocked_at IS NULL)
 AND b.archived_at IS NULL AND r.public_state!='unpublished'), ranked AS (
 SELECT id,(0) AS matches FROM indexed WHERE terms IS NOT NULL ORDER BY matches DESC,slug LIMIT 5
 ), selected AS (
 SELECT id FROM ranked WHERE matches>0 UNION ALL SELECT id FROM indexed WHERE terms IS NULL
 ) SELECT r.id,r.slug,b.show_voters AS showVoters,r.public_title AS title,r.public_description AS description
 FROM selected JOIN requests r ON r.id=selected.id JOIN boards b ON b.id=r.board_id
